cases.title: Endpoint answers with no credential (documents the missing lock)
cases.interpretation: Expected on a default local server. Passing means the server is reachable without any key, so the network boundary (loopback plus tunnel) is the only lock. Recorded as a finding with compensating controls C01 and C16.

cases.title: A bogus key is accepted (the key field is not access control)
cases.interpretation: Expected on a default local server; proves the key field is decorative on a local server.

cases.title: Served model matches the recorded pin
Model-management namespace reachable through the tunnel
cases.interpretation: Read-only listing only; the bench never calls pull, create or delete. Passes once a small path-filtering proxy (C19) limits the tunnel to chat and model-list paths.
